what: A hardcore kick synthesizer powerhouse (gabber, terror, speedcore) and a breakbeat chopper (Based on CHOPPAH) : twenty kick memories with distortion, breaks sliced on the keys, effects, drums, songs with drops, a BEGINNER mode. The editor adds up to 8 breaks: yours or from a library of 70.
author: FLEXOR
sounds: licensed: Amen loops by Cyberworm (Rhythm Lab), royalty free; breaks sampled from records, rights with their owners: funk and soul classics (The Winstons, James Brown, Lyn Collins and others) and hardcore tracks by Akira, Detest, Tripped, Matt Green, Lil Texas, The Satan, Dolphin, Artheist
